{{Quote|Desperate mechanics sometimes cannibalize their scanners for much needed parts: wires, digital readout, energy flux capacitors, and micro-power regulators. Keep in mind that this little box is just a tool, not a replacement hyperdrive motivator.|Platt Okeefe, ''Smuggler's Handbook''|<ref name="PSG" />}}
'''Energy flux capacitors''' were components in [[power scanner]]s, devices used to detect a wide range of energy emissions. According to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]], desperate [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]] would often dismantle and cannibalize power scanners to repurpose their energy flux capacitors, usually to repair [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivators]]. Platt later included a mention of energy flux capacitors in her [[Book/Legends|guide]], the [[Smuggler's Handbook/Legends|''Smuggler's Handbook'']].<ref name="PSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Energy flux capacitors were mentioned in the [[1997]] sourcebook ''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and published by [[West End Games]] for their ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="PSG" /> The device shares its name with the [[w:c:futurepedia:Flux capacitor|flux capacitor]] from the [[Wikipedia:Back to the Future (franchise)|Back to the Future franchise]].<ref name="BTTF">{{VisualMediaCite|title=[[Wikipedia:Back to the Future (film)|''Back to the Future'']]|director=[[Wikipedia:Robert Zemeckis|Robert Zemeckis]]|prod=[[Wikipedia:Amblin Entertainment|Amblin Entertainment]]|year=[[1985]]}}</ref>
